turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

Thank you, Cressida. I found order SC-5209. It has already been delivered, and our policy only allows a delivery address change until the order ships. So I can't change the address on this order. If you have a problem with the delivery itself, please tell me what happened and I'll see what I can do.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.

I understand, and I'm not asking for a return. The rule still applies, though: the delivery address can only be changed before the order ships, and I can't file a change for an order that has already been delivered. If you'd like to discuss this with a colleague, tell me and I'll pass your request on to them.
